name: host_fact
description: Return one compiled registry field for a NAMED machine. Use only when the question names a host and asks what it is or has: its role, status, kind, category, hostname, architecture, system type, management state or network. Never for documentation, notes or general knowledge.

host.description: hostname such as frieren, eisen, delphi

name: notes_search
description: Search the decision-notes store: experiments, proposals, open work and studies. Use for 'which proposals exist about X' or 'open work on X'. Never for documentation files.

name: doc_pages
description: Search this repository's documentation and runbooks for a topic. Use for 'where is X documented', 'how do I do procedure Y', 'find the runbook for Z'.
